items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Harry was a guest one day and -- on one of these particular shows and he came up and sat by me during one of the breaks and said, John,

ctx.x: That's right, that's right. And he was trying to sing like Billy Eckstine at that time, you know, and all the guys would just put him down, you know. But I never did. This is a funny thing, I never did. But when I joined Nat, and Nat had his show, Harry was a guest one day and -- on one of these particular shows and he came up and sat by me during one of the breaks and said, John,
you never thought I'd make it, did you. I said, I never doubted that you'd make it, Harry. He said, Buddy, here I am.
